page.title: Coordination Changes
page.subtitle: History of protocol parameter changes and admin events
page.description: The contract owner can adjust protocol parameters during cycle activation windows. This log records those changes, including Gesture Cost increases, time extensions, and Anchor Distribution settings. Once the owner renounces ownership, these parameters can no longer be changed.

events.stellarEthRecipients: Number of ETH Stellar Selection recipients changed
events.stellarNftRecipients: Number of NFT Stellar Selection recipients changed
events.anchoredRandomWalkRecipients: Number of anchored Random Walk NFT recipients changed
events.randomWalkContractAddress: Random Walk NFT contract address changed
events.randomWalkAnchoringWalletAddress: Random Walk NFT anchoring wallet address changed
events.cosmicSignatureNftAddress: Cosmic Signature NFT contract address changed
events.minimumCstGestureCost: Minimum initial CST Gesture Cost changed
events.nftBaseUri: Cosmic Signature NFT base URI changed
events.ethCalibrationDurationDivisor: ETH Calibration Window duration divisor changed
events.ethCalibrationEndingCostDivisor: ETH Calibration Window ending cost divisor changed
